THE LITANY ENGINE — PHASE 3 QUICK REFERENCE

THE OSSUARY LITANY
Disturbance raises Litany; at 2+, triggering creatures save at round end, while restored names and sustained silence lower the track.
duration: until start of next turn
effect: 1d6 psychic damage; On a failed save, the creature cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn; on a success, it takes half damage and keeps its reactions.
escalation: 2: Skulls turn toward the last triggering creature and the end-of-round save begins | 4: Every empty niche opens; the first failed save each round also knocks the creature Prone
frequency: once per round at litany 2 or higher
reset: The chapel remains silent for ten minutes and at least one displaced remain has been restored. Set Litany to 0.
saving throw: Wisdom DC 14
state: Litany 0–4; starts at 0
threshold: 2
timing: end of round
trigger: disturb remains, loud noise, speak a false name; immediately after event; once per turn
counterplay: action with Intelligence (Investigation or Religion) DC 14: Restore a displaced name or bone to its recorded place and reduce Litany by 1. one minute activity: If every creature remains silent and no remains are disturbed for one minute, reduce Litany by 1.

ROOM SIGNS

01 Skull Lined Corridor
- No recurring sign allocated.

02 Crypt Chapel
- Prayer-Slip Mortar: Fresh wax seals a prayer slip into the wall where no candle can reach.
- Turning Skull Garlands: Every skull in one garland faces the last creature to speak a secret.

03 Reliquary Niche
- Candlewax Tears: Warm wax gathers in the eye sockets of a skull untouched by candlelight.
- Fresh Bone in the Count: One rib in the yellowed arrangement is fresh enough for red marrow to shine at the cut.

04 Ossuary Gallery
- Fresh Bone in the Count: A clean skull has been wired into a dusty row, but the empty wire beside it is still warm.
- Turning Skull Garlands: Every skull in one garland faces the last creature to speak a secret.

05 Sealed Catacomb
- Candlewax Tears: Four wax drops descend in sequence and stop before striking the floor.
